en: Long before video games, Indonesian children played games made from bamboo, wood, shells and rubber bands. Many of these traditional games are still played today in villages, schoolyards and city alleys. This report describes four of them and what children can learn from them.

Congklak. Congklak is a board game for two players. The wooden board usually has two rows of seven small holes, plus a big "home" hole at each end. At the start, each small hole holds seven shells or seeds. Players take turns scooping up the shells from one hole and dropping them one by one into the next holes. The player who collects the most shells in their home wins. In Java the game is also called dakon.

Egrang. Egrang are stilts made from two long bamboo poles, each with a small step tied on. A player stands on the steps, holds the tops of the poles and walks. It takes practice to balance, so beginners start with low steps. Egrang races are a favourite at Independence Day celebrations in many neighbourhoods.

Gasing. A gasing is a spinning top, usually carved from wood. The player winds a string tightly around it, then throws it so the string unwinds and the top spins on the ground. Players compare whose top spins the longest. Gasing is played in many regions, from Sumatra to Kalimantan, and tops come in different shapes and sizes.

Lompat tali. In lompat tali, children link hundreds of rubber bands into a long stretchy rope. Two players hold the ends while the others jump over it. The rope starts at ankle height and rises to the knee, the waist and even above the head. A player who touches the rope swaps with one of the holders.

What children learn. These games build different skills. Congklak needs counting and planning ahead. Egrang and lompat tali build balance, strength and courage. Gasing needs patience and a careful throw. All four are played with others, so children also practise taking turns, following rules and being fair.

Conclusion. Traditional games are cheap to make, can be played almost anywhere, and connect children with the games their parents and grandparents played. Rules and names differ from region to region, which is part of what makes them interesting to learn about.
id: Jauh sebelum ada permainan video, anak-anak Indonesia bermain dengan bambu, kayu, kerang, dan karet gelang. Banyak permainan tradisional ini masih dimainkan sampai sekarang di desa, halaman sekolah, dan gang-gang kota. Laporan ini menjelaskan empat di antaranya dan apa yang bisa dipelajari anak-anak darinya.

Congklak. Congklak adalah permainan papan untuk dua pemain. Papan kayunya biasanya punya dua baris berisi tujuh lubang kecil, ditambah satu lubang besar sebagai "lumbung" di setiap ujung. Pada awal permainan, setiap lubang kecil berisi tujuh kerang atau biji. Pemain bergantian mengambil semua kerang dari satu lubang lalu menjatuhkannya satu per satu ke lubang-lubang berikutnya. Pemain yang mengumpulkan kerang paling banyak di lumbungnya menang. Di Jawa permainan ini juga disebut dakon.

Egrang. Egrang adalah sepasang tongkat panjang dari bambu, masing-masing diberi pijakan kecil. Pemain berdiri di pijakan, memegang ujung atas bambu, lalu berjalan. Perlu latihan untuk menjaga keseimbangan, jadi pemula mulai dengan pijakan yang rendah. Lomba egrang sering diadakan saat perayaan Hari Kemerdekaan di banyak lingkungan.

Gasing. Gasing adalah mainan yang berputar, biasanya dipahat dari kayu. Pemain melilitkan tali erat-erat di sekelilingnya, lalu melemparnya sehingga tali terurai dan gasing berputar di tanah. Para pemain membandingkan gasing siapa yang berputar paling lama. Gasing dimainkan di banyak daerah, dari Sumatra sampai Kalimantan, dan bentuk serta ukurannya beragam.

Lompat tali. Dalam lompat tali, anak-anak merangkai ratusan karet gelang menjadi tali panjang yang lentur. Dua pemain memegang ujungnya sementara yang lain melompatinya. Tali dimulai setinggi mata kaki, lalu naik ke lutut, pinggang, bahkan di atas kepala. Pemain yang menyentuh tali bertukar tempat dengan salah satu pemegang.

Apa yang dipelajari anak. Permainan-permainan ini melatih keterampilan yang berbeda. Congklak memerlukan kemampuan berhitung dan merencanakan langkah. Egrang dan lompat tali melatih keseimbangan, kekuatan, dan keberanian. Gasing memerlukan kesabaran dan lemparan yang cermat. Keempatnya dimainkan bersama orang lain, jadi anak-anak juga berlatih bergiliran, mengikuti aturan, dan bersikap jujur.

Kesimpulan. Permainan tradisional murah dibuat, bisa dimainkan hampir di mana saja, dan menghubungkan anak-anak dengan permainan yang dimainkan orang tua serta kakek nenek mereka. Aturan dan namanya berbeda di tiap daerah, dan itulah salah satu hal yang membuatnya menarik untuk dipelajari.

offlineActivity.en: Interview a grown-up in your family about a game they played as a child. Ask: What was it called? What did you need? How did you play? What did you like about it? Write a short report section with a heading, like the ones in this text, and draw a labelled picture.
offlineActivity.id: Wawancarai orang dewasa di keluargamu tentang permainan yang mereka mainkan saat kecil. Tanyakan: Apa namanya? Apa yang diperlukan? Bagaimana cara memainkannya? Apa yang kamu sukai darinya? Tulis satu bagian laporan pendek dengan subjudul, seperti dalam teks ini, dan gambar ilustrasi yang diberi keterangan.

factChecks.claim: A standard congklak board has two rows of seven small holes and two large store holes; each small hole starts with seven shells or seeds.
Congklak is also known as dakon in Java.
Egrang (bamboo stilts) races are common at Indonesian Independence Day celebrations.
Gasing (spinning tops) are played in many Indonesian regions, including Sumatra and Kalimantan.
Lompat tali uses a rope of linked rubber bands raised from ankle to above head height.
